scripts.dev: IP=$(ip addr | grep 'inet ' | grep -v 127.0.0.1 | awk '{print $2}' | cut -d'/' -f1 | head -n 1) && zola serve --interface 0.0.0.0 --base-url $IP & bunx @tailwindcss/cli -i styles.css -o static/styles.css --watch
scripts.prod: bunx @tailwindcss/cli -i styles.css -o static/styles.css --minify; bun build static/scripts.js --minify --outfile static/scripts.min.js; zola build
